title: Rayman Origins

achievements.reason: No Steam achievement list. Steam app 207490 ("Rayman® Origins") is in the store list and RAWG's store link points to it, but the Steam Web API returned an empty achievement schema and the global percentages call returned HTTP 403. RAWG's achievement list (40 entries) covers Relics, hidden cages, Medallions, speed trophies, Skull Teeth, freeing the Nymphs (Betilla, Holly Luya, Edith Up, Annetta Fish, Helena Handbasket) and level feats in "Polar Pursuit", "Port 'O Panic" and "Aim for the Eel", which could seed an original checklist.

game.title: Rayman Origins
game.blurb: 2D platformer from Ubisoft and UBIart Montpellier (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Ubisoft Casablanca), published by Ubisoft Entertainment and Feral Interactive, released 2011-11-15. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Arcade, Family, Platformer. Chapters use the 64 level names on StrategyWiki's contents page, in groups of eight.

chapters.title: It's a Jungle Out There... to Can't Catch Me!
chapters.summary: Levels 1 to 8 on the StrategyWiki contents page: It's a Jungle Out There..., Geyser Blowout, Punching Plateaus, Go With The Flow, Swinging Caves, Over the Rainbow, Hi-Ho Moskito! and Can't Catch Me!.

chapters.title: Crazy Bouncing to Polar Pursuit
chapters.summary: Levels 9 to 16 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Crazy Bouncing, Best Original Score, Wind of Lose, Skyward Sonata, No Turning Back, Shooting Me Softly, Cacophonic Chase and Polar Pursuit. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.summary: Levels 17 to 24 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Dashing Thru the Snow, Piping Hot!, Mending the Rift, Aim for the Eel!, Sink or Swim, Port 'O Panic, Swimming with Stars and Freaking Flipper. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Bad Bubbles and Beyond to Tricky Treasure Temple
chapters.summary: Levels 25 to 32 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Bad Bubbles and Beyond, Fire When Wetty, Pirate's Treasure!, Moseying the Mountain, Mystical Munkeys, Way of the Electoons, Golly G. Golem and Tricky Treasure Temple. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Outta My Way to Savage Swarms
chapters.summary: Levels 33 to 40 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Outta My Way, Up And Down, Hunter Gatherer, Climb Out, Still Flowing, Poor Little Daisy, Playing in the Shade and Savage Swarms. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Tricky Winds to You're on Fire!

chapters.title: Fickle Fruit to Risky Ruin
chapters.summary: Levels 49 to 56 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Fickle Fruit, My Heartburn's for You, Ice-Fishing Folly, Why So Crabby?, Scuba Shootout, Beware of Mini-Murray, Murray of the Deep and Risky Ruin. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Riding the Storm to Land of the Livid Dead
chapters.summary: Levels 57 to 64 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Riding the Storm, On Top of Old Smokey, Mecha No Mistake!, The Reveal, Get Away!, Shoot for the Stars, Tricky Temple Too and Land of the Livid Dead. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4361). Steam app 207490 returned no achievements (see the collectible note), so steam=None and the chapters come from StrategyWiki page names (swNames). StrategyWiki has "Rayman Origins" at completion stage 0 (also in Category:Stubs); only Controls (about 1,100 characters) and Table of Contents (about 4,200) are written. Gameplay, Characters, Achievements and trophies, Walkthrough and all 64 level pages are linked but not written. The chapters use its level names in contents order, from "It's a Jungle Out There..." to "Land of the Livid Dead"; the contents links do not name the worlds, so groups of eight are our own choice and the summaries are only placeholders built from the page names. No Rayman wiki answered on Fandom: rayman.fandom.com, raymanorigins, rayman-origins, raymanwiki, rayman-wiki and raymanpc all returned HTTP 404. ubisoft.fandom.com answers the API but has no page under "Rayman Origins", so Fandom is marked unverified.
